title: Prospective study on the use of tissue samples and associated patient data in women with benign and malignant gynaecological conditions
summary: Leading HPV tests and Pap smears have limitations, meaning that precancerous lesions may go undetected or be incorrectly identified as such, even though no precancerous lesion is present. The aim is to develop an RNA-based test for cervical cancer screening by establishing a biobank. To this end, samples from the biobank will be compared with cervical cancer screening samples obtained externally.
conditions: Special screening examination for neoplasm of cervix

interventions.name: The aim of this study is to conduct a comprehensive molecular biological analysis of biological material from patients with benign and malignant gynaecological conditions.
